import pytest
from rich.console import Console
import io

def test_soft_wrap_background_color() -> None:
    console = Console(file=io.StringIO(), width=20, soft_wrap=True)
    console.print("soft wrap is on", style="blue on white", soft_wrap=True)
    console.print("still has background color from previous line")
    output = console.file.getvalue()
    assert "blue on white" not in output
